profit_quality.note: Nonrecurring classification item includes financial fair value and disposals; it differs from pure income statement fair-value line. Equity instrument OCI bypasses P&L and must not be added into EPS. Q3 report does not split the total equity-instrument carrying value into a standalone current ChangXin fair value.

valuation_reference.quote_origin: Parent root supplied; morning A close with later H live point, explicit mixed timestamps.
valuation_reference.warning: A-price-equivalent market cap means A price times all A+H shares, useful for A-investor per-share PE but not actual class-by-class aggregate market value. Vendor historical TOTAL_SHARE fields were observed backfilled; use report share capital for historical periods.

illustrative_scenario.assumption: Illustrative Q4 deducted profit equals Q3 deducted profit, not company guidance or verified forecast.

findings.business_growth: Q3 revenue+225.65% YoY, YTD+197.11%. Company attributes to supply-constrained storage price and volume growth, and MCU and other product shipment expansion. IR confirms NOR/NAND/niche DRAM, MCU and analog Q3 sequential revenue growth, but Q3 report does not disclose audited per-product revenue splits.
findings.cycle_risk: IR2026-004 explicitly says recent elevated storage gross margin partly arose because foundry cost increases lag selling-price increases; with cost inflation reflected, overall margins may remain high for a period then gradually return toward normal. H1 and Q3 margins cannot be presumed permanent.
findings.demand_limit: IR says sharp niche-DRAM price increases have already affected consumer demand; supply-demand tension eased but shortage persists. Q4 and Q1 traditionally softer. SLC NAND shortage may persist for longer, large-density NOR moderate increases while small/medium density stable. These are management forecasts, not fulfilled results.
findings.MCU: Management expects 2027 MCU double-digit growth from market share/new products and import substitution; additional inventory replenishment room limited.
findings.quality: YTD OCF about91.49% of reported parent profit and107.32% of deducted profit, supports substantial cash realization. Inventory more than doubles vs year-start; company attributes to stocking. Do not compare this period-end growth mechanically with YoY revenue growth as proof of shortage or oversupply.
findings.net_asset_warning: Other equity investments and OCI drive much of net-asset surge. Unrealized equity marks are not operating profit or spendable cash; low PB on revalued equity can mislead.
findings.peak_judgment: Evidence supports elevated-cycle earnings and future margin-normalization risk; does not prove price/earnings peak already occurred or exact future reversal date.
findings.prior_report_warning: Existing 10/30 report uses an illustrative Q4-constant-profit scenario and unsupported subjective probabilities; do not carry them forward as model-derived odds or company guidance.
